meta.name: iron-proxy-gateway
meta.description: Use Iron Proxy for external accounts and APIs, including GitHub through gh. Connect credentials through the operator console and diagnose blocked requests without exposing tokens or adding unnecessary MCP servers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让外部账号和接口调用都走代理,排查被拦截的请求,不用暴露密钥
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 想让程序安全访问 GitHub 等外部账号,又不想把令牌暴露出去
copy.tagline_en: Route API calls through a proxy, trace blocked requests, keep tokens hidden
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your programs need external accounts like GitHub without exposing tokens

howto.what: 你的对外请求会走会话的 Iron Proxy:访问外部账号或 API(含 GitHub 的 gh)时,凭据由运营控制台配置并经人工批准,Claude 只拿到无效占位符,不索要、不打印真实 token。
howto.when: 当你需要用外部账号或 API(如 GitHub 的 gh),或请求被代理拦下需要排查原因时触发。

say.text: 帮我连一下 GitHub 的 API 账号
say.note: 返回 connect_url,由运营方配置凭据

say.text: 用 gh 看我的 GitHub 仓库,别用真实 token
say.note: 以 gateway-managed 占位符运行

say.text: 这个请求返回 403,帮我查是哪一层拦的
say.note: 报告主机名与错误,请主机侧检查

howto.what_en: Outbound requests go through the session's Iron Proxy. For external accounts or APIs, credentials are set in the operator console and need human approval; Claude only holds a placeholder and never prints real tokens.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need an external account or API such as GitHub via gh, or when a request is blocked and you need to find out why.

say_en.note: Returns a connect_url for the operator to configure

say_en.text: Use gh to list my GitHub repos without a real token
This request got a 403 — which layer blocked it?
say_en.note: Reports hostname and error, asks host-side check
